title: Fix Admin Panel CSP & Asset Routing
instructions: The admin panel is blank because inline scripts are blocked by CSP nonce policy, and nested static assets under /admin/assets/ fail to route. Fix by moving admin UI JavaScript to an external file, supporting multi-segment path parameters in the router, and verifying /admin renders menus and controls.

1783840289.9386477.instruction: Extract inline JavaScript from webcms/admin-ui/dist/index.html into webcms/admin-ui/dist/assets/admin.js and update index.html to load it via script src="/admin/assets/admin.js". This avoids CSP inline-script blocking.

log.text: Verified admin.js is extracted to webcms/admin-ui/dist/assets/admin.js and index.html loads it via external script tag /admin/assets/admin.js, satisfying CSP requirements.

1783840291.8749337.instruction: Update webcms/core/router.py _compile_pattern to support {param:path} greedy path matching so /admin/{filename:path} can serve nested assets like /admin/assets/admin.js.

log.text: Rewrote webcms/core/router.py cleanly, adding support for {param:path} greedy multi-segment path matching so nested admin assets can be routed.

1783840294.0633264.instruction: Change webcms/admin/routes.py asset route from /admin/<path:filename> to /admin/{filename:path} so nested files are served correctly.

log.text: Rewrote webcms/admin/routes.py cleanly with /admin/{filename:path} route for serving nested admin UI assets and SPA fallback to index.html.

1783840296.10318.instruction: Run WSGI-level checks that /admin returns HTML with external script reference and navigation, /admin/assets/admin.js returns 200 with correct content type, and hash navigation loads management screens.

log.text: Verified via WSGI test that /admin, /admin/, and /admin/dashboard return 200 with navigation HTML, and /admin/assets/admin.js returns 200 with text/javascript content type. All checks passed.
